SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
Section 1, Special Branch Station //
REPORT
Date June 27, 1939
Subject Antecedents of A.C. Williams, Russian.
Made by. D.M.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by. C. Gausden D.J.

Alexander Charles WILLIAMS, Russian, born on
June 5, 1899 at Tiflis, Caucasus, Russia. He is reported
to have attended a military school for officers during
the Great War and later to have served in the ranks of one
of the "White" armies. Following the conclusion of the
civil war in Russia he made his way to Poland where he re-
sided until about eight years ago, after which he came to
the Far East to join his mother and younger brother.
In Shanghai he was employed in the Radio Service
Department of the American Engineering Corporation, 403 Bub-
bling Well Road, from 1934 to 1936. Some time in 1937 he
established his own business known as Williams' Radio En-
gineering Co., 601 Bubbling Well Road, which he is still
conducting. He resides at the same address. His brother,
Boris Charles Williams, 30 is reported to have graduated
from the Harbin Polytechnic Institute ( Electrical Engi-
neering Department) and to have been employed for a short
period with the Shanghai Telephone Co., and from 26-10-36
to 31-5-37 - with the Shanghai Power Co. It appears that
at present he assists his brother in business.
Their parents were divorced many years ago, fol-
lowing which their mother ( maiden name M.I. Jovchenko )
married on V.J. George, an officer of the Russian Army.
General George, who at one time was Ataman Semenoff's Chief
of Staff, later served as an advisor to the late Marshal
Chang Tso Ling and from 1922 to 1932 resided at Mukden
where, inter alia he was engaged in journalistic activi-
ties. In December, 1937 he disappeared under mysterious

报告
日期：1939年6月27日
事由：俄国人 A.C. Williams 的背景情况。
制作人：D.M.I. Prokofiev。转呈人：C. Gausden D.J.

亚历山大·查尔斯·威廉斯（Alexander Charles WILLIAMS），俄国人，1899年6月5日出生于俄国高加索地区的第比利斯（Tiflis）。据报，他在第一次世界大战期间曾就读于一所军官军校，后来曾在某支“白军”部队中服役。俄国内战结束后，他前往波兰，在那里居住至约八年前，随后来到远东与母亲及弟弟团聚。
在上海，他于1934年至1936年间受雇于静安寺路403号美国工程公司（American Engineering Corporation）的无线电服务部。1937年的某个时候，他创办了自己的企业，名为威廉斯无线电工程公司（Williams' Radio Engineering Co.），地址为静安寺路601号，目前仍在经营。他居住在同一地址。其弟鲍里斯·查尔斯·威廉斯（Boris Charles Williams），30岁，据报毕业于哈尔滨工业大学（电机工程系），并曾在上海电话公司短期任职，后于1936年10月26日至1937年5月31日期间在上海电力公司任职。目前他似乎在协助其兄经营业务。
他们的父母多年前离异，此后其母（婚前姓名为 M.I. Jovchenko）嫁给了 V.J. George，此人为俄国陆军军官。乔治将军曾任谢苗诺夫（Semenoff）阿塔曼的参谋长，后来担任已故元帅张作霖的顾问，并于1922年至1932年间居住在沈阳，其间从事新闻活动等工作。1937年12月，他在神秘的情况下失踪。
